documents.title: Artificial Intelligence Policy
documents.summary: A short provost-issued policy effective August 2024. It sets no default for AI use and instead makes faculty responsible for deciding whether, when and how AI is used, requires them to say so in syllabi, and makes students responsible for following it. Units may adopt stricter policies; the CTL supplies sample statements from prohibited to unrestricted.
documents.stance_why: The policy states "Faculty are responsible for deciding whether, when, and how generative AI is used in courses, programs, and/or research" and sets no default allow or ban, so it delegates to instructors; units may only be "more restrictive".
